A real photograph, taken with a good phone camera and looking exactly like a phone photograph, of one elderly man of eighty-two, a hospital patient in his room on a hospital ward: the same pale-grey hospital bed, white walls and pale grey floor as in the second reference picture, in a wide picture, the person seen from the knees up and filling most of the picture, everything in sharp focus. Natural colours, soft daylight. The textures of real cotton, skin and hair, with the true depth and the slight lens perspective of a photograph.

The first reference picture shows this person: his face, hair and build stay exactly as in it. He wears a plain pale-blue pyjama top with a collar and pale-blue pyjama trousers. The second reference picture is a real phone photograph of the place: use it for the room, the light and the photographic look, nothing drawn or painted. Its other people do not appear here.

The picture carries no writing, numbers, print, symbol or logo anywhere.

THE PERSON stands beside the bed, leaning slightly forward, one hand pressed on the small of his back, the other hand resting on the bed rail. The face shows clear, real pain, the way a patient looks when telling the nurse where it hurts: the eyebrows drawn together, the eyes narrowed, the lips pressed together. The look goes towards someone just beside the camera.
